sources.authors: Bio-Logic (vendor advertisement; no individual author printed)
sources.title: Bio-Logic EIS Quality Indicators — Pain-free EIS
Controlling Ionic Transport through the PEO-LiTFSI/LLZTO Interface

records.claim_ko: 이 지면은 THD(총고조파왜곡)를 응답의 선형성을 수치로 나타내는 Bio-Logic 의 EIS 품질 지표로 정의한다.
records.claim: The page defines THD (Total Harmonic Distortion) as the Bio-Logic EIS quality indicator that quantifies the linearity of the system's response.
records.where: right column, first bullet below the figure
records.conditions: One-line definition in a vendor advertisement; no formula, unit, harmonic count or threshold is printed.

records.claim_ko: NSD(비정상 왜곡)는 측정에 시간 변화(time variance)와 과도 상태(transient regime)가 미친 영향을 나타내는 지표로 소개된다.
records.claim: NSD (Non-Stationary Distortion) is presented as the indicator of how much time variance and a transient regime affect the measurement.
records.where: right column, second bullet
records.conditions: No formula or threshold printed.

records.claim_ko: NSR(잡음 대 신호비)은 측정 신호가 측정 잡음에 비해 충분히 큰지를 보장하는 지표로 소개된다.
records.claim: NSR (Noise to Signal Ratio) is presented as the indicator that the measured signal is large enough compared with the measurement noise.
records.where: right column, third bullet
records.conditions: No formula or threshold printed. Our reading, not printed: a larger amplitude improves NSR but can worsen THD, so the two indicators pull the amplitude in opposite directions.

records.claim_ko: 이 광고는 올바른 EIS 를 '응답의 선형성'과 '시스템의 시간 불변성' 사이의 까다로운 균형으로 규정하며 숙련자에게도 어렵다고 말한다.
records.claim: The advertisement describes valid EIS as a delicate balance between keeping the response linear and keeping the system time-invariant, which it says troubles even experienced users.
records.where: left column, second paragraph
records.conditions: Qualitative framing only; no criteria given.

records.claim_ko: 그림은 정체를 밝히지 않은 1 Ω 미만 시스템을 전류 진폭 Ia = 50 mA 와 400 mA 로 잰 두 나이퀴스트를 겹쳐 놓았는데, 아크는 겹치고 저주파 끝에서만 갈라지며 어느 쪽이 맞는지는 답을 인쇄하지 않았다.
records.claim: The figure overlays two Nyquist spectra of one unidentified sub-ohm system recorded with current amplitudes Ia = 50 mA and Ia = 400 mA; they coincide over the arc but separate at the low-frequency end, and the page asks which one is correct without printing an answer.
records.where: right column, figure under the heading 'Two curves. But which one is correct?'
records.conditions: System, technique settings and frequency range are not printed; 'Ia' in mA indicates current (galvanostatic) excitation, which is our inference from the label. The diverging low-frequency end is drawn inside a magnifying-glass graphic whose scale is distorted, so no numbers are taken from it; the apex values are read by eye outside it.

records.claim_ko: 품질 지표가 임피던스 실험을 단순화하고 검증해 준다는 주장은 서명 없는 한 쪽 광고의 문구일 뿐이며, 이를 뒷받침하는 방법·데이터·참고문헌은 지면에 없다.
records.claim: The page claims that Bio-Logic's quality indicators simplify and validate impedance experiments, but as an unsigned one-page advertisement it prints no method, data or reference supporting the claim.
records.where: left column, third paragraph
records.conditions: Full-page advertisement in the Summer 2019 issue (the issue's Advertisers Index lists Bio-Logic at pp. 6 and 19); no author, DOI or references.

records.claim_ko: 이 지면에는 THD·NSD·NSR 의 수식, 판정 기준값, 소프트웨어 이름, 파일 컬럼 이름·단위, 바이너리 컬럼 ID 가 전혀 없고 www.bio-logic.net 의 동영상 튜토리얼만 안내한다.
records.claim: The page gives no formula, numerical threshold, software name, file-column name, unit or binary column ID for THD, NSD or NSR, and refers readers only to a video tutorial at www.bio-logic.net.
records.where: bottom of page
records.conditions: Absence checked in the text layer and on the rendered page; EC-Lab is not named anywhere on the page.

records.claim_ko: PEO-LiTFSI/LLZTO 계면 저항만 떼어 내려고 LLZTO 펠릿을 PEO-LiTFSI 막 두 장 사이에 두고 지름 1.27 cm Au 코팅 Ni 핀 사이에서 80 °C·100 kPa 로 컨디셔닝한 Au/PEO-LiTFSI/LLZTO/PEO-LiTFSI/Au 3층 블로킹 셀을 썼다.
records.claim: To isolate the PEO-LiTFSI/LLZTO interfacial resistance the authors used a trilaminar blocking cell, Au/PEO-LiTFSI/LLZTO/PEO-LiTFSI/Au, in which an LLZTO pellet sits between two PEO-LiTFSI films, pressed between 1.27 cm diameter Au-coated Ni pins and heat-conditioned at 80 °C under 100 kPa before EIS.
records.where: Experimental Section, 'Solid-State Cell Assembly and Electrochemical Testing Procedure', first paragraph; schematic in the Fig. 2a inset
records.conditions: Cells were cooled to room temperature after conditioning and then measured at the desired temperature. The area is our pi*d^2/4 from the printed diameter. Layer thicknesses are not given in the main text (assembly details are in supplemental section S3).

records.claim_ko: EIS 는 Biologic VMP-300 으로 30–80 °C 에서 100 mHz–7 MHz, 섭동 전압 100 mV 로 쟀고, 이 진폭에서 응답이 선형이었는지 확인했다는 기술은 본문에 없다.
records.claim: EIS was recorded on a Biologic VMP-300 between 30 °C and 80 °C from 100 mHz to 7 MHz with a 100 mV perturbation voltage, and the main text reports no check that this amplitude kept the response linear.
records.where: Experimental Section, 'Materials Characterization Techniques', last sentence
records.conditions: Points per decade and averaging are not stated; potentiostatic excitation is implied by 'perturbation voltage'.

records.claim_ko: 스펙트럼은 (R_bulk∥CPE_bulk)–(R_interface∥CPE_interface)–M_Au 로 맞췄으며, R_bulk 는 PEO 두 층과 LLZTO 의 합, R_interface 는 두 계면의 합이고 별도의 직렬 저항은 없다.
records.claim: The spectra were fitted with (R_bulk || CPE_bulk) in series with (R_interface || CPE_interface) and a blocking element M_Au, where R_bulk lumps both PEO-LiTFSI layers and the LLZTO, R_interface lumps both PEO-LiTFSI/LLZTO interfaces, and no separate series resistor is used.
records.where: Results and Discussion, 'Interfacial Impedance Analysis Using a Trilaminar Cell Configuration', first paragraph; circuit drawn in Fig. 2b on p. 64
records.conditions: M_Au is described only as the capacitive behaviour of the Au blocking electrode; its impedance function and fitted values are not given. The same circuit is used for the fits in Figs. 4c and 6c.

records.claim_ko: 아크는 커패시턴스를 Irvine·Sinclair·West(1990) 표와 비교해 정했으며, 고주파 아크(~0.71×10⁻⁹ F/cm²)는 PEO+LLZTO 벌크, 저주파 아크(0.55×10⁻⁶ F/cm²)는 PEO-LiTFSI/LLZTO 계면이다.
records.claim: The arcs were assigned by comparing their capacitances with Irvine, Sinclair and West (1990): the high-frequency arc (~0.71 x 10^-9 F/cm2) is the combined bulk of PEO and LLZTO and the low-frequency arc (0.55 x 10^-6 F/cm2) is the PEO-LiTFSI/LLZTO interface.
records.where: Results and Discussion, 'Interfacial Impedance Analysis Using a Trilaminar Cell Configuration', first paragraph

values.reference: J. T. S. Irvine, D. C. Sinclair, A. R. West, Adv. Mater. 2, 132 (1990) [ref. 34]

records.conditions: Untreated LLZTO, 30 °C (Fig. 2). The numbers are the CPE parameters of Fig. 2c quoted as capacitances.

records.claim_ko: 맞춘 CPE 파라미터를 지수 α = 0.73–1.0 과 함께 F/cm² 로 표에 적고, 유효 커패시턴스로 환산했다는 말 없이 문헌 커패시턴스와 바로 비교했다.
records.claim: The fitted CPE parameters are tabulated in F/cm2 next to exponents alpha = 0.73-1.0 and compared with literature capacitances directly, without any stated conversion to effective capacitance.
records.where: Results and Discussion, first paragraph (the comparison); tables in Fig. 2c p. 64, Fig. 4c p. 66, Fig. 6c p. 68
records.math: C_eff/A = (Q * R^(1-alpha))^(1/alpha)   [Hsu-Mansfeld; applied by us, not by the article; Q per cm2, R in ohm*cm2]
records.conditions: For alpha < 1 a CPE parameter has units F*s^(alpha-1)/cm2, so 'F/cm2' is nominal. Derived values come from wrdkit.eis.capacitance.effective_capacitance applied to the printed R and Q; they are not in the article.

records.claim_ko: 처리하지 않은 LLZTO 의 30 °C 스펙트럼은 R_bulk = 27.54 kΩ·cm², R_interface = 96.88 kΩ·cm² 로 맞춰져 계면이 셀 저항의 대부분을 차지하며, 본문은 평균 R_interface 를 96 kΩ·cm² 로 적는다.
records.claim: For untreated LLZTO at 30 °C the fit gave R_bulk = 27.54 kOhm*cm2 and R_interface = 96.88 kOhm*cm2, so the interface dominates the cell resistance, and the text quotes the average R_interface as 96 kOhm*cm2.
records.where: Results and Discussion, first paragraph; parameters in the Fig. 2c table on p. 64
records.conditions: Fig. 2a axes are area-normalised (ohm*cm2). The salt ratio of this cell is not stated in the caption. M_Au values are not tabulated.

records.claim_ko: LLZTO 입계 임피던스는 LLZTO 벌크의 2.5 % 에 그쳐 회로에서 뺐으므로, 이 블로킹 대칭셀의 두 번째 아크는 입계가 아니다.
records.claim: The LLZTO grain-boundary impedance was left out of the circuit because it contributed only 2.5% of the LLZTO bulk impedance, so the second arc of this blocking symmetric cell is not a grain boundary.
records.where: Results and Discussion, first paragraph
records.conditions: Hot-pressed LLZTO (1225 °C, 40 min, 47 MPa), wet-polished to 0.1 um. How the 2.5% was obtained is not described in the main text.

records.claim_ko: 회로의 R_interface 는 대칭 스택의 두 PEO-LiTFSI/LLZTO 계면을 합친 값이며, 보고된 Ω·cm² 값을 계면 하나로(÷2) 환산했는지는 적혀 있지 않다.
records.claim: R_interface in the circuit represents both PEO-LiTFSI/LLZTO interfaces of the symmetric stack in series, and the article does not say whether the reported ohm*cm2 values were halved to give a per-interface value.
records.where: Fig. 2 caption, part (b)
records.conditions: Applies to every R_interface value in the article (96 kOhm*cm2, 180 ohm*cm2, 421 ohm*cm2).

records.claim_ko: 고분자/세라믹 계면을 쉽게 건너려면 R_interface 가 약 100 Ω·cm²(다른 곳에서는 < 100 Ω·cm²)여야 한다는 목표를 두고, Li-ion 셀 전체 임피던스를 ~10–100 Ω·cm² 로 든다.
records.claim: For facile transport across the polymer/ceramic interface the authors set a target R_interface of about 100 ohm*cm2 (elsewhere stated as < 100 ohm*cm2) and cite ~10-100 ohm*cm2 as typical total Li-ion cell impedance.
records.where: Results and Discussion, 'Interfacial Impedance Analysis Using a Trilaminar Cell Configuration', second paragraph
records.conditions: 30 °C. A design goal, not a measured limit; no derivation is given. The '< 100' form is in the Significance section and the 10-100 range in the Conclusion (both p. 67).

records.claim_ko: LLZTO 를 아르곤에서 100–800 °C(100 °C 간격, 3 h) 열처리하면 R_interface 가 점점 줄어 700 °C 에서 최소(30 °C 평균 180 Ω·cm²)가 되고, 800 °C 에서는 Li 손실로 La₂Zr₂O₇ 가 생겨 다시 커진다고 저자는 본다.
records.claim: Heat-treating LLZTO in argon (100-800 °C in 100 °C steps, 3 h) lowered R_interface progressively to a minimum at 700 °C, averaging 180 ohm*cm2 at 30 °C, while 800 °C raised it again, which the authors attribute to Li loss forming La2Zr2O7.
records.where: right column, second paragraph (continuation of 'Effect of Heat-Treatment Temperature of LLZTO on the Interfacial Impedance'); data in Fig. 4a
records.conditions: 30 °C, [EO]:[Li] = 27:1, three trilaminar cells per heat treatment (mean and SD in Fig. 4a); cells assembled immediately after heat treatment to limit glove-box contamination. Fig. 4a values are read by eye from a linear axis.

records.claim_ko: 700 °C 열처리 후 벌크 아크는 거의 그대로(R_bulk 11.24→9.16 kΩ·cm²)였고 계면 아크만 무너졌는데(R_interface 14.57→0.20 kΩ·cm²), 저자는 LLZTO 가 분해되지 않았고 표면 불순물층이 제거되었기 때문이라고 설명한다.
records.claim: Heat treatment at 700 °C left the bulk arc nearly unchanged (R_bulk 11.24 -> 9.16 kOhm*cm2) while the interface arc collapsed (R_interface 14.57 -> 0.20 kOhm*cm2), which the authors explain by the absence of LLZTO decomposition and the removal of the surface impurity layer.
records.where: right column, first paragraph; Fig. 4b-c
records.conditions: 30 °C, one representative cell each (Fig. 4b), fitted with the Fig. 2b circuit. The figure labels the interface features with 25 Hz and 150 Hz; the article does not say these are apex frequencies, and our apex estimates from the Fig. 4c parameters differ (12.5 Hz and 754 Hz).

records.claim_ko: 700 °C 처리 후 계면 반원은 전체 나이퀴스트에서는 보이지 않고 확대 삽입 그림에서만 보이는데, 맞춤은 여전히 R_bulk 의 약 2 % 인 0.20 kΩ·cm² 를 준다.
records.claim: After the 700 °C treatment the interface semicircle is not apparent in the full-scale Nyquist plot and is visible only in a magnified inset, yet the fit still assigns it 0.20 kOhm*cm2, about 2% of R_bulk.
records.where: right column, first paragraph; Fig. 4b inset
records.conditions: 30 °C; the Fig. 4b inset spans Z_real of about 8-12 x10^3 ohm*cm2. Parameter uncertainties are not reported.

records.claim_ko: 처리하지 않은 LLZTO 의 계면 저항은 글 안에서도 크게 다르며(그림 2c 96.88, 그림 4c 14.57, 그림 4a 평균 약 11 kΩ·cm²) 저자는 불순물층 두께를 통제할 수 없어서라고 보는데, 본문의 '~250배 감소'는 인쇄된 값(96.88 kΩ·cm² → 180 Ω·cm², 약 540배)과 맞지 않는다.
records.claim: Untreated LLZTO gives very different interface resistances within the article (96.88 kOhm*cm2 in Fig. 2c, 14.57 kOhm*cm2 in Fig. 4c, a mean of about 11 kOhm*cm2 in Fig. 4a), which the authors attribute to the uncontrolled impurity-layer thickness, and the stated ~250x reduction does not follow from the printed numbers (96.88 kOhm*cm2 -> 180 ohm*cm2 is about 540x).
records.where: right column, 'Effect of Heat-Treatment Temperature of LLZTO on the Interfacial Impedance', second paragraph
records.conditions: Fig. 4a reading is approximate. The article does not reconcile the Fig. 2c and Fig. 4 values.

records.claim_ko: PEO-LiTFSI 의 [EO]:[Li] 를 바꾸면(400 °C 처리 LLZTO) 15:1 에서 R_interface 가 최소(30 °C 평균 421 Ω·cm², 27:1 보다 약 4배 낮음)가 되고, 염이 더 많으면 다시 커지는데 저자는 LiTFSI 석출 때문이라고 본다.
records.claim: Varying [EO]:[Li] in PEO-LiTFSI (with 400 °C-treated LLZTO) minimised R_interface at 15:1, averaging 421 ohm*cm2 at 30 °C and about 4x lower than at 27:1, while higher salt contents raised it again, which the authors attribute to LiTFSI precipitation.
records.where: left column, second paragraph; Fig. 6 on p. 68
records.conditions: 30 °C, three membranes per composition. The text's list of prepared ratios omits 15:1, which Fig. 6a plots. The Fig. 6c value for 15:1 (0.44 kOhm*cm2) is one cell; 421 ohm*cm2 is the stated average. R_bulk also changes with salt because PEO is part of the bulk arc.

records.claim_ko: R_interface 는 모든 열처리 조건에서 온도가 오르면 줄었고 30–80 °C 에서 꺾임 없는 직선이었으므로, 저자는 보통 두 구간을 보이는 PEO-LiTFSI 전도도에 R_interface 가 강하게 묶여 있지 않다고 결론짓지만 활성화에너지 수치는 본문에 없다.
records.claim: R_interface fell with rising cell temperature for every heat treatment and its temperature dependence was linear over 30-80 °C with no break at the PEO melting point, from which the authors conclude that R_interface is not strongly tied to PEO-LiTFSI conductivity (which usually shows two regimes); no activation energy is printed in the magazine text.
records.where: top of page, both columns (continuation of the heat-treatment section)
records.conditions: Data are in supplementary Fig. S5 (online, not in the magazine); the plot type, slopes and the PEO melting temperature are not given in the main text.

records.claim_ko: 고분자/가닛 계면 저항이 큰 주된 원인으로 저항성 Li₂CO₃ 표면층(표면 산소 밀도를 높여 PEO 산소와 반발하고 Li 호핑 거리를 늘림)과 저농도 PEO 에서 고농도 LLZTO 로 넘어가는 급격한 Li 이온 농도 차를 든다.
records.claim: The authors propose two main causes of high polymer/garnet interfacial resistance: a resistive Li2CO3 surface layer, which also raises the surface oxygen density, repels PEO oxygen and lengthens the Li hop, and the abrupt Li-ion concentration step from the low-concentration PEO to the high-concentration LLZTO.
records.where: right column, first paragraph (end of the introduction)
records.conditions: Stated as the authors' belief; supported indirectly by the heat-treatment and salt-ratio trends, with no direct measurement of the Li2CO3 layer thickness in the main text.

records.claim_ko: 표면 불순물과 농도 차이 외에도 두 전해질의 화학적 상호작용, LLZTO 표면 거칠기, 그리고 온도·스택 압력 같은 외부 조건이 R_interface 를 바꿀 수 있다고 적는다.
records.claim: Besides surface impurities and the concentration mismatch, the authors note that chemical interactions between the electrolytes, LLZTO surface roughness, and external factors such as temperature and stack pressure may also change R_interface.
records.where: left column, 'Factors Affecting the Interfacial Impedance between PEO-LiTFSI and LLZTO', first paragraph
records.conditions: Pressure and roughness effects were not studied in this article.

records.claim_ko: 이온이 고분자/세라믹 계면을 쉽게 건넌다면 복합 전해질의 전도도는 세라믹 비율과 함께 올라야 하는데, 문헌(표 I)과 이 연구(그림 1b)에서 그렇지 않으므로 전류는 주로 PEO 로 흐르고 계면이 병목이라고 추론한다.
records.claim: If ions crossed the polymer/ceramic interface easily, composite conductivity would rise with the ceramic fraction; because literature composites (Table I) and the authors' own composite (Fig. 1b) do not, the authors infer that current flows mainly through the PEO matrix and that the interface is the bottleneck.
records.where: left column, introduction; Table I and Fig. 1
records.conditions: Fig. 1b temperature is not stated; values read by eye. Table I entries are literature values as printed (0.95 x 10^-2 and 0.7 x 10^-5 mS/cm written out).

records.claim_ko: 본문에는 전극 지름만 있고 층 두께는 없어(조립 상세는 보충 S3) 면적 정규화 커패시턴스를 Irvine 표의 C·l/A 로 바꿀 수 없으며, 벌크 판정은 면적당 값에 기대고 있다.
records.claim: The main text gives the electrode diameter but no layer thicknesses, deferring assembly details to supplemental section S3, so the area-normalised capacitances cannot be converted to the C*l/A form of the Irvine table and the bulk assignment rests on per-area values.
records.where: Experimental Section, 'Solid-State Cell Assembly and Electrochemical Testing Procedure', first paragraph
records.conditions: Derived limits use our bulk ceiling C*l/A < 1e-11 F/cm (capacitance.PROCESSES) with our effective capacitances. For layers in series the geometric capacitance is dominated by the thinnest, lowest-permittivity layer, so one total thickness is not a meaningful cell constant (our reasoning, not the article's).

records.claim_ko: 저자는 30 °C 스펙트럼을 반원 둘과 Au 이온 블로킹 전극의 용량성 꼬리로 읽지만, 인쇄된 다섯 스펙트럼 중 셋(그림 2a, 4b 미처리, 6b 27:1)은 최저 주파수에서도 −Z″ 가 Z′ 보다 작아 꼬리가 나이퀴스트 평면에서 72–77° 로 솟는데도 절대 위상이 약 −22~−28° 에 머문다.
records.claim: The authors read the 30 °C spectra as two semicircles plus a capacitive tail from the ion-blocking Au electrodes, yet in three of the five printed spectra (Figs. 2a, 4b untreated, 6b 27:1) that tail ends at the lowest frequency with -Z'' still below Z', giving an absolute phase of only about -22 to -28 degrees even though the tail rises at 72-77 degrees in the Nyquist plane.
records.where: Results and Discussion, 'Interfacial Impedance Analysis Using a Trilaminar Cell Configuration', first paragraph; spectra in Fig. 2a (p. 64), Fig. 4b (p. 66), Fig. 6b (p. 68)
records.conditions: Points digitised by eye from 500-dpi renders of the printed figures; exact frequencies of the points are not printed (the sweep ends at 100 mHz), and the verdict uses only their order. Verdicts from running wrdkit.eis.derive.blocking_verdict on the digitised points.
